map.扫描件方向不统一（横竖交错）时，逐页或批量旋转到正确方向，便于阅读打印。: When scanned pages have inconsistent orientation (mixed landscape and portrait), rotate page by page or in batch to the correct direction for easier reading and printing.
map.批量处理一份全部倒装的文档时，用「全部旋转」模式一次性校正。: When an entire document is upside down, use the "Rotate All" mode to correct it in one go.
map.个别页面方向异常时，用「单页旋转」单独微调，不影响其余页面。: When only some pages are oriented wrongly, use "Rotate Single Page" to fine-tune them without touching the rest.
map.选中目标页面后点「左转 90°」或「右转 90°」，缩略图实时预览旋转效果并显示: Select the target pages and click "Rotate Left 90°" or "Rotate Right 90°"; the thumbnail previews the rotation live and shows the current angle. Three modes are supported - single page, batch and rotate all - and you can reset to the original orientation with one click. Rotation only changes page orientation and never modifies text or image content.
map.旋转会改动原文内容吗？: Does rotating change the original content?
map.不会。旋转仅改变页面方向（视觉角度），文字、图片等内容保持不变，可随时一键重置回: No. Rotation only changes page orientation (the visual angle); text, images and other content stay identical, and you can reset to the original orientation at any time with one click.
